declarations.name: normalized_l1_le_two_over_mass
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem normalized_l1_le_two_over_mass
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (p q : Ω → ℚ)
    (_hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (hq : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω)
    (Z W D ζ : ℚ)
    (hZ : Z = ∑ ω, p ω) (hW : W = ∑ ω, q ω)
    (hZpos : 0 < Z) (hWpos : 0 < W)
    (hD : ∑ ω, |p ω - q ω| ≤ D)
    (hDnonneg : 0 ≤ D)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζZ : ζ ≤ Z) :
    (∑ ω, |p ω / Z - q ω / W|) ≤ 2 * D / ζ

declarations.name: bayes_numerator_l1_le

    (hβ : ∀ ω, |L ω - M ω| ≤ β) :
    (∑ ω, |b.prob ω * L ω - b.prob ω * M ω|) ≤ β

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_l1_stability_likelihood
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_l1_stability_likelihood
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L M : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω) (hM : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω)
    (β ζ : ℚ)
    (hβnonneg : 0 ≤ β)
    (hβ : ∀ ω, |L ω - M ω| ≤ β)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (hLmass : ζ ≤ evidenceMass b L)
    (hMmass : ζ ≤ evidenceMass b M) :
    beliefL1Distance
        (conditionByWeight b L hL (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hLmass))
        (conditionByWeight b M hM (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hMmass))
      ≤ 2 * β / ζ

declarations.name: bayes_numerator_l1_le_of_prior_error
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem bayes_numerator_l1_le_of_prior_error
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b c : RationalBelief Ω) (L : Ω → ℚ)
    (K α : ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hLK : ∀ ω, L ω ≤ K)
    (hprior : beliefL1Distance b c ≤ α) :
    (∑ ω, |b.prob ω * L ω - c.prob ω * L ω|) ≤ K * α

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_l1_stability_prior
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_l1_stability_prior
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b c : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (K α ζ : ℚ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hLK : ∀ ω, L ω ≤ K)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hprior : beliefL1Distance b c ≤ α)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (hbmass : ζ ≤ evidenceMass b L)
    (hcmass : ζ ≤ evidenceMass c L) :
    beliefL1Distance
        (conditionByWeight b L hL (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hbmass))
        (conditionByWeight c L hL (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hcmass))
      ≤ 2 * (K * α) / ζ

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_l1_stability_combined
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_l1_stability_combined
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b c : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L M : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω) (hM : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω)
    (K α β ζ : ℚ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hMK : ∀ ω, M ω ≤ K)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hprior : beliefL1Distance b c ≤ α)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hlik : ∀ ω, |L ω - M ω| ≤ β)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (hbL : ζ ≤ evidenceMass b L)
    (hbM : ζ ≤ evidenceMass b M)
    (hcM : ζ ≤ evidenceMass c M) :
    beliefL1Distance
        (conditionByWeight b L hL (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hbL))
        (conditionByWeight c M hM (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hcM))
      ≤ 2 * β / ζ + 2 * (K * α) / ζ

    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z]

declarations.name: condition_pushforward_approximately_commutes
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem condition_pushforward_approximately_commutes
    {Ω : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z) (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L : Ω → ℚ) (Lbar : Z → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω) (hLbar : ∀ z, 0 ≤ Lbar z)
    (β ζ : ℚ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hclose : ∀ ω, |L ω - Lbar (φ ω)| ≤ β)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (hfine : ζ ≤ evidenceMass b L)
    (hcoarse : ζ ≤ evidenceMass (pushforwardBelief φ b) Lbar) :
    beliefL1Distance
      (pushforwardBelief φ
        (conditionByWeight b L hL (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hfine)))
      (conditionByWeight (pushforwardBelief φ b) Lbar hLbar
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hcoarse))
      ≤ 2 * β / ζ

declarations.name: pushforwardRow_comp
declarations.statement_excerpt:

declarations.name: l1_pushforward_triangle

theorem l1_pushforward_triangle
    {S : Type u} {M : Type w} {Z : Type x}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype M] [Fintype Z]
    [DecidableEq M] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : S → M) (ψ : M → Z)
    (p : S → ℚ) (q : M → ℚ) (r : Z → ℚ)
    (δ₁ δ₂ : ℚ)
    (h₁ : l1RowDistance (pushforwardRow φ p) q ≤ δ₁)
    (h₂ : l1RowDistance (pushforwardRow ψ q) r ≤ δ₂) :

declarations.name: approximate_abstraction_comp
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem approximate_abstraction_comp
    {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {M : Type w} {Z : Type x}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype M] [Fintype Z]
    [DecidableEq M] [DecidableEq Z] [DecidableEq A]
    (raw : FiniteStochasticControlSystem S A)
    (mid : FiniteStochasticControlSystem M A)
    (absSys : FiniteStochasticControlSystem Z A)
    (φ : S → M) (ψ : M → Z)
    (ε₁ δ₁ R₁ ε₂ δ₂ R₂ : ℚ)
    (h₁ : ApproximateStochasticAbstraction raw mid φ ε₁ δ₁ R₁)
    (h₂ : ApproximateStochasticAbstraction mid absSys ψ ε₂ δ₂ R₂) :
    ApproximateStochasticAbstraction raw absSys (ψ ∘ φ)
      (ε₁ + ε₂) (δ₁ + δ₂) R₂

declarations.name: approximate_composite_horizon_bound
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem approximate_composite_horizon_bound
    {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {M : Type w} {Z : Type x}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype M] [Fintype Z]
    [DecidableEq M] [DecidableEq Z] [DecidableEq A]
    (raw : FiniteStochasticControlSystem S A)
    (mid : FiniteStochasticControlSystem M A)
    (absSys : FiniteStochasticControlSystem Z A)
    (φ : S → M) (ψ : M → Z)
    (ε₁ δ₁ R₁ ε₂ δ₂ R₂ : ℚ)
    (h₁ : ApproximateStochasticAbstraction raw mid φ ε₁ δ₁ R₁)
    (h₂ : ApproximateStochasticAbstraction mid absSys ψ ε₂ δ₂ R₂)
    (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    |stochasticHorizonValue raw n s -
      stochasticHorizonValue absSys n (ψ (φ s))| ≤
      (n : ℚ) * (ε₁ + ε₂) + (δ₁ + δ₂) * R₂ *
        ((n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) - 1) / 2)

declarations.name: projected_expectation_error_le

theorem projected_expectation_error_le
    {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] [DecidableEq A]
    (raw : FiniteStochasticControlSystem S A)

    (V : Z → ℚ) (B : ℚ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hV : ∀ z, |V z| ≤ B)
    (s : S) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ raw.actions) :

theorem linked_expectation_error_le

declarations.name: approximate_value_sufficient_of_budget
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem approximate_value_sufficient_of_budget
    {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {Z : Type w}

    (h : ApproximateStochasticAbstraction raw absSys φ ε δ R)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hη : (n : ℚ) * ε + δ * R * ((n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) - 1) / 2) ≤ η) :
    ∀ s, |stochasticHorizonValue raw n s -
      stochasticHorizonValue absSys n (φ s)| ≤ η

declarations.name: abstract_optimal_action_raw_regret_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem abstract_optimal_action_raw_regret_le
    {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] [DecidableEq A]
    (raw : FiniteStochasticControlSystem S A)
    (absSys : FiniteStochasticControlSystem Z A)
    (φ : S → Z) (ε δ R : ℚ)
    (h : ApproximateStochasticAbstraction raw absSys φ ε δ R)
    (n : ℕ) (s : S) (a : A)
    (haopt : StochasticBellmanOptimalAt absSys n (φ s) a) :
    stochasticHorizonValue raw (n + 1) s - stochasticQValue raw n s a ≤
      2 * approxBudget ε δ R (n + 1)

declarations.name: archiveLikelihood_append

declarations.name: replayArchive_nil
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem replayArchive_nil
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) :
    replayArchive b [] (by rw [archiveEvidenceMass_nil]; norm_num) = b

declarations.name: archiveEvidenceMass_append_factor
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem archiveEvidenceMass_append_factor
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (xs ys : List (LikelihoodFactor Ω))
    (hx : 0 < archiveEvidenceMass b xs) :
    archiveEvidenceMass b (xs ++ ys) =
      archiveEvidenceMass b xs *
        evidenceMass (replayArchive b xs hx) (archiveLikelihood ys)

declarations.name: archiveEvidenceMass_append_pos
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem archiveEvidenceMass_append_pos
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (xs ys : List (LikelihoodFactor Ω))
    (hx : 0 < archiveEvidenceMass b xs)
    (hy : 0 < evidenceMass (replayArchive b xs hx) (archiveLikelihood ys)) :
    0 < archiveEvidenceMass b (xs ++ ys)

declarations.name: replayArchive_append
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem replayArchive_append
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (xs ys : List (LikelihoodFactor Ω))
    (hx : 0 < archiveEvidenceMass b xs)
    (hy : 0 < evidenceMass (replayArchive b xs hx) (archiveLikelihood ys)) :
    replayArchive b (xs ++ ys) (archiveEvidenceMass_append_pos b xs ys hx hy) =
      conditionByWeight (replayArchive b xs hx) (archiveLikelihood ys)
        (archiveLikelihood_nonneg ys) hy

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_congr_belief
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_congr_belief
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b c : RationalBelief Ω) (L : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hb : b = c)
    (hpb : 0 < evidenceMass b L)
    (hpc : 0 < evidenceMass c L) :
    conditionByWeight b L hL hpb = conditionByWeight c L hL hpc

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_congr_likelihood
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_congr_likelihood
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (L M : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω) (hM : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω)
    (hLM : L = M)
    (hpL : 0 < evidenceMass b L)
    (hpM : 0 < evidenceMass b M) :
    conditionByWeight b L hL hpL = conditionByWeight b M hM hpM

declarations.name: replayAtResolution_comp
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem replayAtResolution_comp
    {Ω : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Z]
    [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Y) (ψ : Y → Z)
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (fs : List (LikelihoodFactor Ω))
    (hpos : 0 < archiveEvidenceMass b fs) :
    pushforwardBelief ψ (replayAtResolution φ b fs hpos) =
      replayAtResolution (ψ ∘ φ) b fs hpos

declarations.name: replay_resolution_is_pushforward
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem replay_resolution_is_pushforward
    {Ω : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z)
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (fs : List (LikelihoodFactor Ω))
    (hpos : 0 < archiveEvidenceMass b fs) :
    replayAtResolution φ b fs hpos =
      pushforwardBelief φ (replayArchive b fs hpos)

    (B n : Nat) (s : State Ω P) (hs : BudgetSafe p B s) :
    ∃ plan : Guarded.Plan (Action P C) Bool n,
      Guarded.Legal (controller p) s plan ∧
      Guarded.TreeSafe (controller p) (BudgetSafe p B) s plan ∧
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s plan = Guarded.value (controller p) n s ∧

        Guarded.planValue (controller p) s other ≤ Guarded.planValue (controller p) s plan

    (choose : Nat → State Ω P → Action P C)

    (ha : ∀ k s, Allowed p s (choose k s))
    (he : ∀ k s a, Allowed p s a →
      |Guarded.qValue (controller p) k s a - estimate k s a| ≤ eta k)
    (hm : ∀ k s a, Allowed p s a → estimate k s a ≤ estimate k s (choose k s) + tau k)
    (B n : Nat) (s : State Ω P) (hs : BudgetSafe p B s) :
    Guarded.TreeSafe (controller p) (BudgetSafe p B) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    0 ≤ Guarded.value (controller p) n s - Guarded.planValue (controller p) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    Guarded.value (controller p) n s - Guarded.planValue (controller p) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ≤
      Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 * eta k + tau k) n

declarations.name: artifact_bayesian_model_policy
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem artifact_bayesian_model_policy {M : Type*}
    (p : Protocol Ω P C O)
    (model : Guarded.System (RationalBelief Ω × M) (Action P C) Bool)
    (phi : State Ω P → RationalBelief Ω × M)
    (W : Nat → (RationalBelief Ω × M) → ℚ)
    (eps alpha beta : ℚ) (L R chi residual : Nat → ℚ)
    (hc : Guarded.BayesianModelCertificate (controller p) model phi
      (fun s => s.belief) W eps alpha beta L R chi residual)
    (estimate : Nat → State Ω P → Action P C → ℚ)
    (choose : Nat → State Ω P → Action P C) (codeError tau : Nat → ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ k s, Allowed p s (choose k s))
    (he : ∀ k s a, Allowed p s a →
      |Guarded.tableQ model (W k) (phi s) a - estimate k s a| ≤ codeError k)
    (hm : ∀ k s a, Allowed p s a → estimate k s a ≤ estimate k s (choose k s) + tau k)
    (B n : Nat) (s : State Ω P) (hs : BudgetSafe p B s) :
    Guarded.TreeSafe (controller p) (BudgetSafe p B) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    0 ≤ Guarded.value (controller p) n s -
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    Guarded.value (controller p) n s -
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ≤
      Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 *
        (Guarded.modelQBudget eps (Guarded.bayesianTransportBudget alpha beta L R chi) residual k +
          codeError k) + tau k) n

declarations.name: confirm_contract
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem confirm_contract (j : Job) (s out : Session j) (t : Attempts.Ticket)
    (r : CommitRecovery.Commit j) (actual : StoreView)
    (h : confirm j s t r actual = .ok out) :
    r.intent.sequence = s.checkpoint.next ∧
    t.fee = fee (protocol j) s.checkpoint.state.core r.intent.action ∧
    Attempts.settle s.ledger t = .ok out.ledger ∧
    CommitRecovery.acknowledge j s.checkpoint r actual = .ok out.checkpoint

declarations.name: bayesUpdate_mul_predictive

    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (E : RationalChannel Ω O) (o : O)
    (hpos : 0 < predictiveProb b E o) (ω : Ω) :

declarations.name: predictive_mul_posteriorExpectedUtility

    predictiveProb b E o *
        posteriorExpectedUtility (bayesUpdate b E o hpos) utility a =
      signalActionScore b.prob utility E o a

declarations.name: evidenceMass_pushforward

theorem evidenceMass_pushforward

declarations.name: condition_pushforward_commutes
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem condition_pushforward_commutes
    {Ω : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z) (b : RationalBelief Ω) (Lbar : Z → ℚ)
    (hLbar : ∀ z, 0 ≤ Lbar z)
    (hpos : 0 < evidenceMass b (fun ω => Lbar (φ ω))) :
    let hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Lbar (φ ω) := fun ω => hLbar (φ ω)
    let hposCoarse : 0 < evidenceMass (pushforwardBelief φ b) Lbar

declarations.name: predictiveProb_pushforward

theorem predictiveProb_pushforward

    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [Fintype O] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z) (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (E : RationalChannel Ω O) (Ebar : RationalChannel Z O)
    (hfactor : ∀ ω o, E.prob ω o = Ebar.prob (φ ω) o)
    (o : O) :
    predictiveProb b E o =
      predictiveProb (pushforwardBelief φ b) Ebar o

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_mul_evidence
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_mul_evidence
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (L : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hpos : 0 < evidenceMass b L) (ω : Ω) :

declarations.name: bayesUpdate_eq_conditionByWeight
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem bayesUpdate_eq_conditionByWeight
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    {O : Type v} [Fintype O]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (E : RationalChannel Ω O) (o : O)
    (hpos : 0 < predictiveProb b E o) :
    bayesUpdate b E o hpos =
      conditionByWeight b (fun ω => E.prob ω o)
        (fun ω => E.nonneg ω o) hpos

declarations.name: evidenceMass_condition_compose
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem evidenceMass_condition_compose
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L₁ L₂ : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL₁ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₁ ω)
    (_hL₂ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₂ ω)
    (h₁ : 0 < evidenceMass b L₁) :
    evidenceMass b L₁ *
        evidenceMass (conditionByWeight b L₁ hL₁ h₁) L₂ =
      evidenceMass b (fun ω => L₁ ω * L₂ ω)

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_compose
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_compose
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L₁ L₂ : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL₁ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₁ ω)
    (hL₂ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₂ ω)
    (h₁ : 0 < evidenceMass b L₁)
    (h₂ : 0 < evidenceMass (conditionByWeight b L₁ hL₁ h₁) L₂) :
    let L₁₂ := fun ω => L₁ ω * L₂ ω
    let hL₁₂ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₁₂ ω := fun ω => mul_nonneg (hL₁ ω) (hL₂ ω)
    let h₁₂ : 0 < evidenceMass b L₁₂

declarations.name: conditionByWeight_commute
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditionByWeight_commute
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]
    (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (L₁ L₂ : Ω → ℚ)
    (hL₁ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₁ ω)
    (hL₂ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L₂ ω)
    (h₁ : 0 < evidenceMass b L₁)
    (h₂_after₁ : 0 < evidenceMass (conditionByWeight b L₁ hL₁ h₁) L₂)
    (h₂ : 0 < evidenceMass b L₂)
    (h₁_after₂ : 0 < evidenceMass (conditionByWeight b L₂ hL₂ h₂) L₁) :
    conditionByWeight (conditionByWeight b L₁ hL₁ h₁) L₂ hL₂ h₂_after₁ =
      conditionByWeight (conditionByWeight b L₂ hL₂ h₂) L₁ hL₁ h₁_after₂

declarations.name: bayesian_link_expectation_error
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem bayesian_link_expectation_error (raw : System S A O)
    (model : System (RationalBelief Ω × M) A O)
    (phi : S → RationalBelief Ω × M) (belief : S → RationalBelief Ω)
    (link : BayesianStepLink raw model phi belief)
    (W : (RationalBelief Ω × M) → ℚ)
    (L R alpha beta chi : ℚ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hLip : ∀ m b c, |W (b, m) - W (c, m)| ≤ L * beliefL1Distance b c)
    (hbound : ∀ z, |W z| ≤ R)
    (s : S) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ raw.actions s)
    (hb : beliefL1Distance (belief s) (phi s).1 ≤ alpha)
    (hE : ∀ w, (∑ o, |(link.rawExperiment s a).prob w o -
      (link.modelExperiment (phi s) a).prob w o|) ≤ beta)
    (hcodec : (∑ o, raw.prob s a o * beliefL1Distance
      (phi (raw.step s a o)).1 (bayesUpdateTotal (belief s) (link.rawExperiment s a) o)) ≤ chi) :
    |expectation raw (fun t => W (phi t)) s a - expectation model W (phi s) a| ≤
      L * chi + (2 * L + R) * (alpha + beta)

    (hcode : ∀ t, beliefL1Distance (belief t) (phi t).1 ≤ chi)
    (hstep : ∀ s a o, belief (raw.step s a o) = bayesUpdateTotal (belief s) (E s a) o)
    (s : S) (a : A) :
    (∑ o, raw.prob s a o * beliefL1Distance (phi (raw.step s a o)).1
      (bayesUpdateTotal (belief s) (E s a) o)) ≤ chi

    (hLip : ∀ o x y, |f o x - f o y| ≤ L * beliefL1Distance x y)
    (hbound : ∀ o x, |f o x| ≤ R) :
    |(∑ o, predictiveProb b E o * f o (bayesUpdateTotal b E o)) -
      ∑ o, predictiveProb c F o * f o (bayesUpdateTotal c F o)| ≤
      (2 * L + R) * jointObservationL1 b c E F

    (hb : beliefL1Distance b c ≤ alpha)
    (hE : ∀ w, (∑ o, |E.prob w o - F.prob w o|) ≤ beta) :
    |(∑ o, predictiveProb b E o * f o (bayesUpdateTotal b E o)) -
      ∑ o, predictiveProb c F o * f o (bayesUpdateTotal c F o)| ≤
      (2 * L + R) * (alpha + beta)

    let r := recommend m ka ko horizon budget fallback s
    r.work ≤ r.reservation ∧ r.reservation ≤ budget ∧ r.work + r.remaining = budget

declarations.name: recommend_gap
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem recommend_gap (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (ka ko budget n : Nat) (fallback : S → A)
    (hf : ∀ s, fallback s ∈ sys.actions s) (R : ℚ)
    (hr : ∀ s a, a ∈ sys.actions s → |sys.reward s a| ≤ R) (s : S) :
    let r := recommend m ka ko (n + 1) budget fallback s
    Guarded.value sys (n + 1) s - Guarded.qValue sys n s r.action ≤
      2 * ((n + 1 - r.depth : Nat) : ℚ) * R

declarations.name: recommendation_policy_regret
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem recommendation_policy_regret (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (ka ko : Nat) (caps : Nat → Nat) (fallback : S → A)
    (hf : ∀ s, fallback s ∈ sys.actions s) (R : ℚ)
    (hr : ∀ s a, a ∈ sys.actions s → |sys.reward s a| ≤ R) (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    let selector := fun k t => (recommend m ka ko (k + 1) (caps k) fallback t).action
    0 ≤ Guarded.value sys n s - Guarded.planValue sys s (Guarded.policyPlan sys selector n s) ∧
    Guarded.value sys n s - Guarded.planValue sys s (Guarded.policyPlan sys selector n s) ≤
      Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 * ((k + 1 - selectedDepth ka ko (k + 1) (caps k) : Nat) : ℚ) * R) n

declarations.name: learned_episode_coverage
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem learned_episode_coverage
    (law : CalibrationSchedule.Law Ω) (md : QModel r c)
    (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),
      CalibrationSchedule.eventMass law (fun ω => count j ω = k) =
        FiniteCalibration.mass (n j) k.val (p j))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (selectWarm ω) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (selectCold ω) = cp) :
    1 - ∑ j, alpha j ≤ CalibrationSchedule.eventMass law (fun ω =>
      EpisodeCertified (replaceProbabilityBands md
        (learnedBand (n (selectWarm ω)) (count (selectWarm ω) ω).val
          (m (selectWarm ω)) (alpha (selectWarm ω)))
        (learnedBand (n (selectCold ω)) (count (selectCold ω) ω).val
          (m (selectCold ω)) (alpha (selectCold ω)))) wp cp
        d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross)

declarations.name: binomial_failure_eq
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem binomial_failure_eq (law : Law Ω) (n m : Nat) (alpha p : ℚ)
    (count : Ω → Fin (n + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count ω = k) = FiniteCalibration.mass n k.val p) :
    eventMass law (fun ω =>
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains n (count ω).val m alpha p) =
        FiniteCalibration.missMass n m alpha p

declarations.name: binomial_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem binomial_failure_le (law : Law Ω) (n m : Nat) (hm : 0 < m)
    (alpha p : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (count : Ω → Fin (n + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count ω = k) = FiniteCalibration.mass n k.val p) :
    eventMass law (fun ω =>
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains n (count ω).val m alpha p) ≤ alpha

declarations.name: scheduled_binomial_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem scheduled_binomial_failure_le [Fintype J] (law : Law Ω)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count j ω = k) =
        FiniteCalibration.mass (n j) k.val (p j)) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => ∃ j,
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains (n j) (count j ω).val (m j) (alpha j) (p j)) ≤
        ∑ j, alpha j

    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count j ω = k) =
        FiniteCalibration.mass (n j) k.val (p j))
    (select : Ω → J) :
    eventMass law (fun ω =>
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains (n (select ω)) (count (select ω) ω).val
        (m (select ω)) (alpha (select ω)) (p (select ω))) ≤ ∑ j, alpha j

theorem selected_binomial_coverage [Fintype J] (law : Law Ω)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)

theorem scheduled_binomial_coverage [Fintype J] (law : Law Ω)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)

theorem calibrated_conclusion_coverage [Fintype J] (law : Law Ω)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),

       (r.intent.sequence = c.next ∧ r.intent.before = view c.state ∧

declarations.name: sufficientForQueries_antitone
sufficientForQueries_insert_iff
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem sufficientForQueries_insert_iff
    {Q : Type z} [DecidableEq Q]
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} {Y : Type w}
    {φ : X → Z} {tasks : Q → X → Y} {queries : Finset Q} {q : Q} :
    SufficientForQueries φ tasks (insert q queries) ↔
      TaskSufficient φ (tasks q) ∧ SufficientForQueries φ tasks queries

declarations.name: mem_sufficientContexts_iff
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem mem_sufficientContexts_iff
    {R : Type z} [DecidableEq R]
    {Q : Type*} [DecidableEq Q]
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} {Y : Type w}
    (family : ContextFamily R X Z)
    (designs : Finset R) (tasks : Q → X → Y) (queries : Finset Q) (r : R) :
    r ∈ sufficientContexts family designs tasks queries ↔
      r ∈ designs ∧ SufficientForQueries (family.encode r) tasks queries

declarations.name: finite_minimum_cost_sufficient_context_exists
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem finite_minimum_cost_sufficient_context_exists
    {R : Type z} [DecidableEq R]
    {Q : Type*} [DecidableEq Q]
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} {Y : Type w}
    (family : ContextFamily R X Z)
    (designs : Finset R) (tasks : Q → X → Y) (queries : Finset Q)
    (hne : (sufficientContexts family designs tasks queries).Nonempty) :
    ∃ chosen,
      chosen ∈ designs ∧
      SufficientForQueries (family.encode chosen) tasks queries ∧
      ∀ r ∈ designs,
        SufficientForQueries (family.encode r) tasks queries →
        family.cost chosen ≤ family.cost r

    {small large : Finset Q} (hsub : small ⊆ large) :

      sufficientContexts family designs tasks small

    (family : ContextFamily R X Z)
    (designs : Finset R) (tasks : Q → X → Y)
    {small large : Finset Q} {smallChoice largeChoice : R}
    (hsub : small ⊆ large)

theorem exact_request_replay_is_free :
    begin (authority 100) final good = .ok (unchanged final)

declarations.name: interrupted_evaluation_abandonment_retains_charge
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem interrupted_evaluation_abandonment_retains_charge :
    let cancelled := ⟨afterReserve.current, none, [⟨bad, .abandoned⟩]⟩
    abandon afterReserve bad.key = .ok ⟨cancelled, true, 0, 0⟩ ∧
    cancelled.current.evaluationSpent = 3 ∧ cancelled.current.active = .dynamic

declarations.name: omitted_failed_trial_is_rejected
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem omitted_failed_trial_is_rejected :
    replay (authority 100) start [.begin good, .finish good.key] =
      .error "stale complete parent state"

declarations.name: unchanged_version_does_not_erase_cost
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem unchanged_version_does_not_erase_cost :
    afterBad.current.active = start.current.active ∧
    afterBad.current.revision = start.current.revision ∧
    afterBad.current ≠ start.current

declarations.name: forged_active_checkpoint_rejected
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem forged_active_checkpoint_rejected :
    restore (authority 100) .dynamic [] final = .error "log/checkpoint mismatch"

declarations.name: abandoned_result_cannot_promote
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem abandoned_result_cannot_promote :
    finish (authority 100)
      ⟨afterReserve.current, none, [⟨bad, .abandoned⟩]⟩ bad.key =
      .ok (unchanged ⟨afterReserve.current, none, [⟨bad, .abandoned⟩]⟩)

declarations.name: findClosed_append_new
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem findClosed_append_new (key : String) (xs : List (Closed V)) (r : Closed V)
    (h : findClosed key xs = none) (hk : r.ticket.key = key) :
    findClosed key (xs ++ [r]) = some r

declarations.name: reserve_exact
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem reserve_exact [DecidableEq V] (a : Authority V) (t : Ticket V)
    (xs : List (Closed V)) (hk : findClosed t.key xs = none)
    (hf : Funded a t.before t.proposal) :
    begin a ⟨t.before, none, xs⟩ t =
      .ok ⟨⟨charged a t, some t, xs⟩, true, a.evaluationCost t.proposal.candidate, 0⟩

declarations.name: finish_reserved_exact
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem finish_reserved_exact [DecidableEq V] (a : Authority V) (t : Ticket V)
    (xs : List (Closed V)) (hk : findClosed t.key xs = none)
    (hf : Funded a t.before t.proposal) :
    finish a ⟨charged a t, some t, xs⟩ t.key =
      .ok ⟨⟨(Upgrade.step a t.before t.proposal).next, none,
          xs ++ [⟨t, .evaluated (Upgrade.step a t.before t.proposal).outcome⟩]⟩,
        true, 0, (Upgrade.step a t.before t.proposal).switchDebit⟩

declarations.name: begin_idempotent

theorem begin_idempotent [DecidableEq V] (a : Authority V) (j : Journal V)
    (t : Ticket V) (r : Reply V) (h : begin a j t = .ok r) :
    begin a r.journal t = .ok (unchanged r.journal)

declarations.name: finish_idempotent
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem finish_idempotent [DecidableEq V] (a : Authority V) (j : Journal V)
    (key : String) (r : Reply V) (h : finish a j key = .ok r) :

declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem abandon_idempotent (j : Journal V) (key : String) (r : Reply V)

declarations.name: finish_does_not_lower_utility
declarations.statement_excerpt:

    (j : Journal V) (key : String) (r : Reply V) (h : finish a j key = .ok r) :

declarations.name: paid_trace_exact_accounting
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem paid_trace_exact_accounting [DecidableEq V] (a : Authority V)
    {j : Journal V} {cmds : List (Command V)} {out : Journal V} {ev sw : Nat}
    (h : PaidTrace a j cmds out ev sw) :
    out.current.evaluationSpent = j.current.evaluationSpent + ev ∧
    out.current.switchSpent = j.current.switchSpent + sw

    (hs : Safe a j) (h : PaidTrace a j cmds out ev sw) :
    j.current.evaluationSpent + j.current.switchSpent + ev + sw ≤ a.credits

declarations.name: horizonValue_succ_eq_max
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem horizonValue_succ_eq_max
    {S A : Type*} [DecidableEq A]
    (sys : FiniteControlSystem S A) (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    horizonValue sys (n + 1) s =
      (sys.actions.image (qValue sys n s)).max'
        (sys.actions_nonempty.image _)

declarations.name: bellman_action_exists
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem bellman_action_exists
    {S A : Type*} [DecidableEq A]
    (sys : FiniteControlSystem S A) (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    ∃ a ∈ sys.actions, ∀ b ∈ sys.actions,
      qValue sys n s b ≤ qValue sys n s a

declarations.name: horizonValue_eq_qValue_of_optimal
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem horizonValue_eq_qValue_of_optimal
    {S A : Type*} [DecidableEq A]
    (sys : FiniteControlSystem S A) (n : ℕ) (s : S) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ sys.actions)
    (hmax : ∀ b ∈ sys.actions, qValue sys n s b ≤ qValue sys n s a) :
    horizonValue sys (n + 1) s = qValue sys n s a

declarations.name: finite_horizon_optimal_action_exists
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem finite_horizon_optimal_action_exists
    {S A : Type*} [DecidableEq A]
    (sys : FiniteControlSystem S A) (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    ∃ a ∈ sys.actions,
      horizonValue sys (n + 1) s = qValue sys n s a

declarations.name: actionEval_score
declarations.statement_excerpt:
@[simp] theorem actionEval_score (m : Model S A O) (next : S → Result A)
    (s : S) (a : A) :
    (actionEval m next s a).score = m.reward s a +
      (m.observations.map (fun o => m.prob s a o * (next (m.step s a o)).score)).sum

declarations.name: actionEval_work
declarations.statement_excerpt:
@[simp] theorem actionEval_work (m : Model S A O) (next : S → Result A)
    (s : S) (a : A) :
    (actionEval m next s a).work = 1 +
      (m.observations.map (fun o => 1 + (next (m.step s a o)).work)).sum

declarations.name: best_none_iff
declarations.statement_excerpt: theorem best_none_iff (xs : List (Candidate A)) : best xs = none ↔ xs = []

declarations.name: best_spec
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem best_spec (xs : List (Candidate A)) (hne : xs ≠ []) :
    ∃ c, best xs = some c ∧ c ∈ xs ∧ ∀ d ∈ xs, d.score ≤ c.score

declarations.name: observation_sum
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem observation_sum (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (f : O → ℚ) :
    (m.observations.map f).sum = ∑ o, f o

declarations.name: actionEval_exact
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem actionEval_exact (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (next : S → Result A) (n : Nat)
    (hn : ∀ s, (next s).score = Guarded.value sys n s) (s : S) (a : A) :
    (actionEval m next s a).score = Guarded.qValue sys n s a

declarations.name: backupEval_correct
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem backupEval_correct (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (next : S → Result A) (n : Nat)
    (hn : ∀ s, (next s).score = Guarded.value sys n s) (s : S) :
    (backupEval m next s).score = Guarded.value sys (n + 1) s ∧
    ∃ a, (backupEval m next s).choice = some a ∧ a ∈ sys.actions s ∧
      ∀ b ∈ sys.actions s, Guarded.qValue sys n s b ≤ Guarded.qValue sys n s a

declarations.name: evaluate_exact
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem evaluate_exact (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    (evaluate m n s).score = Guarded.value sys n s

declarations.name: evaluate_choice_optimal
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem evaluate_choice_optimal (m : Model S A O) (sys : Guarded.System S A O)
    (h : Realizes m sys) (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    ∃ a, (evaluate m (n + 1) s).choice = some a ∧ a ∈ sys.actions s ∧
      ∀ b ∈ sys.actions s, Guarded.qValue sys n s b ≤ Guarded.qValue sys n s a

declarations.name: report_expectation
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem report_expectation (E : RationalChannel Ω O) (f : O → D)
    (w : Ω) (g : D → ℚ) :
    (∑ d, (reportChannel E f).prob w d * g d) = ∑ o, E.prob w o * g (f o)

declarations.name: predictive_report
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem predictive_report (b : RationalBelief Ω) (E : RationalChannel Ω O)
    (f : O → D) (d : D) :
    predictiveProb b (reportChannel E f) d =
      ∑ o, if f o = d then predictiveProb b E o else 0

declarations.name: predictive_report_expectation
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem predictive_report_expectation (b : RationalBelief Ω)
    (E : RationalChannel Ω O) (f : O → D) (g : D → ℚ) :
    (∑ d, predictiveProb b (reportChannel E f) d * g d) =
      ∑ o, predictiveProb b E o * g (f o)

declarations.name: posterior_report_scaled
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem posterior_report_scaled (b : RationalBelief Ω) (E : RationalChannel Ω O)
    (f : O → D) (d : D) (w : Ω) :
    predictiveProb b (reportChannel E f) d *
        (bayesUpdateTotal b (reportChannel E f) d).prob w =
      ∑ o, if f o = d then predictiveProb b E o * (bayesUpdateTotal b E o).prob w else 0

declarations.name: posterior_report_mixture
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem posterior_report_mixture (b : RationalBelief Ω) (E : RationalChannel Ω O)
    (f : O → D) (d : D) (w : Ω)
    (h : 0 < predictiveProb b (reportChannel E f) d) :
    (bayesUpdateTotal b (reportChannel E f) d).prob w =
      (∑ o, if f o = d then predictiveProb b E o *
        (bayesUpdateTotal b E o).prob w else 0) / predictiveProb b (reportChannel E f) d

declarations.name: rejection_likelihood
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem rejection_likelihood (E : RationalChannel Ω O) (f : O → Bool) (w : Ω) :
    (reportChannel E f).prob w false = ∑ o, if f o = false then E.prob w o else 0

declarations.name: silent_predictive
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem silent_predictive (b : RationalBelief Ω) (d e : D) :

declarations.name: silent_posterior
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem silent_posterior (b : RationalBelief Ω) (d e : D) :
    bayesUpdateTotal b (silentChannel (Ω := Ω) d) e = b

declarations.name: greedyPointCoverCount_eq_pointCoverNumber

declarations.name: legal_plan_safe

theorem legal_plan_safe (sys : System S A O) (safe : S → Prop)

declarations.name: safe_optimal_plan_exists
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem safe_optimal_plan_exists (sys : System S A O) (safe : S → Prop)

    ∃ p : Plan A O n,
      Legal sys s p ∧ TreeSafe sys safe s p ∧

declarations.name: mixture_q_le_value
declarations.statement_excerpt:

    (hA : raw.actions s = model.actions (phi s))
    (hQ : ∀ a ∈ raw.actions s,
      |qValue raw n s a - tableQ model W (phi s) a| ≤ D) :
    |value raw (n + 1) s - backup model W (phi s)| ≤ D

declarations.name: model_q_error_step
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem model_q_error_step (raw : System S A O) (model : System Z A O)
    (phi : S → Z) (W : ℕ → Z → ℚ) (eps : ℚ) (transport residual : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hc : ModelCertificate raw model phi W eps transport residual)
    (n : ℕ) (D : ℚ)
    (hprev : ∀ s, |value raw n s - W n (phi s)| ≤ D)
    (s : S) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ raw.actions s) :
    |qValue raw n s a - tableQ model (W n) (phi s) a| ≤ D + eps + transport n

declarations.name: model_value_error

    (hc : ModelCertificate raw model phi W eps transport residual)

declarations.name: model_decoded_policy_regret
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem model_decoded_policy_regret (raw : System S A O) (model : System Z A O)
    (phi : S → Z) (W : ℕ → Z → ℚ) (eps : ℚ) (transport residual : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hc : ModelCertificate raw model phi W eps transport residual)
    (estimate : ℕ → S → A → ℚ) (choose : ℕ → S → A)
    (codeError tau : ℕ → ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ n s, choose n s ∈ raw.actions s)
    (he : ∀ n s a, a ∈ raw.actions s →
      |tableQ model (W n) (phi s) a - estimate n s a| ≤ codeError n)
    (hm : ∀ n s a, a ∈ raw.actions s → estimate n s a ≤ estimate n s (choose n s) + tau n)
    (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    0 ≤ value raw n s - planValue raw s (policyPlan raw choose n s) ∧
    value raw n s - planValue raw s (policyPlan raw choose n s) ≤
      regretBudget (fun k => 2 * (modelQBudget eps transport residual k + codeError k) + tau k) n

theorem conditional_success_formula :
    conditionalSuccess p a b hp0 hp1 ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1 =
      p * a / (p * a + (1 - p) * b)

declarations.name: retained_event_conditioning
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem retained_event_conditioning (hret : 0 < p * a + (1 - p) * b)
    (event : Bool → Prop) :
    eventMass (retainedLaw p a b hp0 hp1 ha0 hb0 hret) event =
      eventMass (attemptLaw p a b hp0 hp1 ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1)
        (fun ω => ∃ x, report ω = some x ∧ event x) /
      eventMass (attemptLaw p a b hp0 hp1 ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1)
        (fun ω => ω.2 = true)

declarations.name: equal_retention_preserves_parameter
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem equal_retention_preserves_parameter (r : ℚ) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    conditionalSuccess p r r hp0 hp1 (le_of_lt hr0) hr1 (le_of_lt hr0) hr1 = p

declarations.name: equal_retention_mass
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem equal_retention_mass (r : ℚ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    eventMass (attemptLaw p r r hp0 hp1 hr0 hr1 hr0 hr1)
      (fun ω => ω.2 = true) = r

declarations.name: conditional_parameter_preserved_iff
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditional_parameter_preserved_iff (hp_pos : 0 < p) (hp_lt : p < 1)
    (hret : 0 < p * a + (1 - p) * b) :
    conditionalSuccess p a b hp0 hp1 ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1 = p ↔ a = b

declarations.name: outcome_dependent_censoring_counterexample
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem outcome_dependent_censoring_counterexample :
    conditionalSuccess (1 / 2) 1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) = 1

declarations.name: outcome_dependent_censoring_changes_parameter
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem outcome_dependent_censoring_changes_parameter :
    conditionalSuccess (1 / 2) 1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ≠ (1 / 2 : ℚ)

declarations.name: deadline_second_retention_predictable
declarations.statement_excerpt:

declarations.name: deadline_current_bit_fair_given_past

theorem deadline_current_bit_fair_given_past (past current : Bool) :
    eventMass deadlineLaw (fun ω => ω.1 = past ∧ ω.2 = current) /
      eventMass deadlineLaw (fun ω => ω.1 = past) = 1 / 2

declarations.name: deadline_completion_mass
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem deadline_completion_mass :

declarations.name: deadline_unconditional_first_success

declarations.name: deadline_conditioned_zero_count

declarations.name: deadline_conditioned_count_not_binomial

declarations.name: observedCounts_faithful
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem observedCounts_faithful
    (n : J → Nat) (key : J → K)
    (source : Ω → K → List Bool) (trace : Ω → List (Option K))
    (stream : (j : J) → Ω → Sample (n j))
    (hprefix : ∀ j ω, sampleList (stream j ω) = (source ω (key j)).take (n j)) :
    ObservedCalibration.Faithful n (fun j => streamCount (stream j))
      (observedCounts n key source trace)

declarations.name: revealed_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem revealed_failure_le
    (law : Law Ω) (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (key : J → K) (source : Ω → K → List Bool) (trace : Ω → List (Option K))
    (stream : (j : J) → Ω → Sample (n j))
    (hprefix : ∀ j ω, sampleList (stream j ω) = (source ω (key j)).take (n j))
    (hlaw : ∀ j, ProductLaw law (n j) (p j) (stream j)) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => ∃ j k, observedCounts n key source trace j ω = some k ∧
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains (n j) k.val (m j) (alpha j) (p j)) ≤ ∑ j, alpha j

declarations.name: revealed_episode_coverage
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem revealed_episode_coverage {r c : Nat}
    (law : Law Ω) (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (key : J → K) (source : Ω → K → List Bool) (trace : Ω → List (Option K))
    (stream : (j : J) → Ω → Sample (n j))
    (hprefix : ∀ j ω, sampleList (stream j ω) = (source ω (key j)).take (n j))
    (hlaw : ∀ j, ProductLaw law (n j) (p j) (stream j))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (selectWarm ω) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (selectCold ω) = cp) :
    1 - ∑ j, alpha j ≤ eventMass law (fun ω => ∀ planned,
      Affine.ObservedCalibration.observedPlan md n m alpha
        (observedCounts n key source trace) selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned →
      EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross)

declarations.name: shared_stream_episode_coverage
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem shared_stream_episode_coverage {r c : Nat}
    (law : Law Ω) (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (N : K → Nat) (p : K → ℚ) (base : (k : K) → Ω → Sample (N k))
    (hlaw : ∀ k, ConditionalLaw law (N k) (p k) (base k))
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha : J → ℚ) (key : J → K)
    (hn : ∀ j, n j ≤ N (key j))
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hp1 : ∀ k, p k ≤ 1)
    (trace : Ω → List (Option K))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectWarm ω)) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectCold ω)) = cp) :
    1 - ∑ j, alpha j ≤ eventMass law (fun ω => ∀ planned,
      Affine.ObservedCalibration.observedPlan md n m alpha
        (observedCounts n key (fun ω k => sampleList (base k ω)) trace)
        selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned →
      EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross)

declarations.name: shared_stream_issued_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem shared_stream_issued_failure_le {r c : Nat}
    (law : Law Ω) (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (N : K → Nat) (p : K → ℚ) (base : (k : K) → Ω → Sample (N k))
    (hlaw : ∀ k, ConditionalLaw law (N k) (p k) (base k))
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha : J → ℚ) (key : J → K)
    (hn : ∀ j, n j ≤ N (key j))
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hp1 : ∀ k, p k ≤ 1)
    (trace : Ω → List (Option K))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectWarm ω)) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectCold ω)) = cp) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => ∃ planned,
      Affine.ObservedCalibration.observedPlan md n m alpha
        (observedCounts n key (fun ω k => sampleList (base k ω)) trace)
        selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned ∧
      ¬ EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross) ≤
      ∑ j, alpha j

declarations.name: vectorMass_card_sum
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem vectorMass_card_sum (n k : Nat) (p : ℚ) :
    (∑ s : Sample n, if s.card = k then vectorMass n p s else 0) =
      FiniteCalibration.mass n k p

declarations.name: vectorMass_sum_one
declarations.statement_excerpt:

    ∑ s : Sample n, vectorMass n p s = 1

declarations.name: eventMass_split
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem eventMass_split (law : Law Ω) (a b : Ω → Prop) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => a ω ∧ b ω) +
      eventMass law (fun ω => a ω ∧ ¬ b ω) = eventMass law a

declarations.name: vectorMass_eq_product
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem vectorMass_eq_product {n : Nat} (p : ℚ) (s : Sample n) :
    vectorMass n p s = ∏ i : Fin n, if i ∈ s then p else 1 - p

declarations.name: conditional_pattern_mass
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditional_pattern_mass (law : Law Ω) (n : Nat) (p : ℚ)
    (stream : Ω → Sample n) (h : ConditionalLaw law n p stream)
    (seen target : Sample n) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => Matches seen target (stream ω)) =
      ∏ i ∈ seen, if i ∈ target then p else 1 - p

declarations.name: conditional_implies_product
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditional_implies_product (law : Law Ω) (n : Nat) (p : ℚ)
    (stream : Ω → Sample n) (h : ConditionalLaw law n p stream) :
    ProductLaw law n p stream

declarations.name: bernoulliLaw_product
declarations.statement_excerpt:

    ProductLaw (bernoulliLaw n p hp0 hp1) n p id

declarations.name: count_fiber_eq_binomial
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem count_fiber_eq_binomial (law : Law Ω) (n : Nat) (p : ℚ)
    (stream : Ω → Sample n) (h : ProductLaw law n p stream) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => streamCount stream ω = k) =
      FiniteCalibration.mass n k.val p

declarations.name: conditional_count_fiber_eq_binomial

    (stream : Ω → Sample n) (h : ConditionalLaw law n p stream) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => streamCount stream ω = k) =

declarations.name: stream_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem stream_failure_le (law : Law Ω) (n m : Nat) (hm : 0 < m)
    (alpha p : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (stream : Ω → Sample n) (h : ProductLaw law n p stream) :
    eventMass law (fun ω =>
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains n (streamCount stream ω).val m alpha p) ≤ alpha

declarations.name: sampleList_count_fiber_eq_binomial

    (stream : Ω → Sample n) (h : ConditionalLaw law n p stream) :

declarations.name: mem_truncateSample

declarations.name: matches_truncate

    (seen target : Sample n) (s : Sample N) :
    Matches seen target (truncateSample n hn s) ↔
      Matches (seen.image (Fin.castLE hn)) (target.image (Fin.castLE hn)) s

declarations.name: conditional_truncate
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem conditional_truncate (law : Law Ω) (N : Nat) (p : ℚ)
    (stream : Ω → Sample N) (h : ConditionalLaw law N p stream)
    (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ N) :

declarations.name: prefix_count_fiber_eq_binomial
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem prefix_count_fiber_eq_binomial (law : Law Ω) (N : Nat) (p : ℚ)

    (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ N) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :

declarations.name: observed_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem observed_failure_le
    (law : Law Ω) (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count j ω = k) = FiniteCalibration.mass (n j) k.val (p j))
    (observed : (j : J) → Ω → Option (Fin (n j + 1)))
    (faithful : Faithful n count observed) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => ∃ j k, observed j ω = some k ∧
      ¬ FiniteCalibration.Contains (n j) k.val (m j) (alpha j) (p j)) ≤
      ∑ j, alpha j

declarations.name: observed_coverage
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem observed_coverage
    (law : Law Ω) (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count j ω = k) = FiniteCalibration.mass (n j) k.val (p j))
    (observed : (j : J) → Ω → Option (Fin (n j + 1)))
    (faithful : Faithful n count observed) :
    1 - ∑ j, alpha j ≤ eventMass law (fun ω => ∀ j k,
      observed j ω = some k → FiniteCalibration.Contains (n j) k.val (m j) (alpha j) (p j))

declarations.name: observedPlan_certified
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem observedPlan_certified (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (observed : (j : J) → Ω → Option (Fin (n j + 1)))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (selectWarm ω) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (selectCold ω) = cp) (ω : Ω)
    (hall : ∀ j k, observed j ω = some k →
      FiniteCalibration.Contains (n j) k.val (m j) (alpha j) (p j)) :
    ∀ planned, observedPlan md n m alpha observed selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned →
      EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross

declarations.name: observed_episode_coverage
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem observed_episode_coverage [Fintype Ω] [Fintype J]
    (law : Law Ω) (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha p : J → ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∀ j, p j ≤ 1)
    (count : (j : J) → Ω → Fin (n j + 1))
    (count_law : ∀ j (k : Fin (n j + 1)),
      eventMass law (fun ω => count j ω = k) = FiniteCalibration.mass (n j) k.val (p j))
    (observed : (j : J) → Ω → Option (Fin (n j + 1)))
    (faithful : Komorebi.AVOC.ObservedCalibration.Faithful n count observed)
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (selectWarm ω) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (selectCold ω) = cp) :
    1 - ∑ j, alpha j ≤ eventMass law (fun ω => ∀ planned,
      observedPlan md n m alpha observed selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned →
        EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross)

declarations.name: pushforwardBelief_prob
declarations.statement_excerpt:
@[simp] theorem pushforwardBelief_prob
    {Ω : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z) (b : RationalBelief Ω) (z : Z) :
    (pushforwardBelief φ b).prob z = pushforwardRow φ b.prob z

declarations.name: refinement_mass_conservation
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem refinement_mass_conservation
    {Hfine : Type u} {Hcoarse : Type v}
    [Fintype Hfine] [Fintype Hcoarse] [DecidableEq Hcoarse]
    (decode : Hfine → Hcoarse) (b : RationalBelief Hfine) (h : Hcoarse) :
    (pushforwardBelief decode b).prob h =
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Hfine => decode x = h), b.prob x

declarations.name: pushforwardBelief_comp
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem pushforwardBelief_comp
    {Ω : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Z]
    [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Y) (ψ : Y → Z) (b : RationalBelief Ω) :
    pushforwardBelief ψ (pushforwardBelief φ b) =
      pushforwardBelief (ψ ∘ φ) b

declarations.name: pushforward_dirac
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem pushforward_dirac
    {Ω : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Ω] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z) (x : Ω) :

declarations.name: no_universal_belief_recovery_of_collision
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem no_universal_belief_recovery_of_collision
    {Ω : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Ω] [DecidableEq Z]
    (φ : Ω → Z) {x y : Ω} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hφ : φ x = φ y) :

    (hg : emissionCharge n m c.candidate.width ≤ generation)
    (hs : worthExploring calls (executionCost p)
      (menuFloor (executionCost p) n m lo) (coldFloor n m lo) = false) :

        (widthFloor (coefficients p)) probeCredit ps).lower)
      (coldFloor n m (scan (coefficients p).linear

      calls * executionCost (choose p c)

declarations.name: recorder_episode_coverage
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem recorder_episode_coverage {r c : Nat}
    (law : Law Ω) (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (N : K → Nat) (p : K → ℚ) (base : (k : K) → Ω → Sample (N k))
    (hlaw : ∀ k, ConditionalLaw law (N k) (p k) (base k))
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha : J → ℚ) (key : J → K)
    (hn : ∀ j, n j ≤ N (key j))
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hp1 : ∀ k, p k ≤ 1)
    (commands : Ω → List (RecorderReveal.Command K))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectWarm ω)) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectCold ω)) = cp) :
    1 - ∑ j, alpha j ≤ eventMass law (fun ω => ∀ planned,
      recorderPlan md n m alpha key (fun ω k => sampleList (base k ω)) commands
        selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned →
      EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross)

declarations.name: recorder_issued_failure_le
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem recorder_issued_failure_le {r c : Nat}
    (law : Law Ω) (md : QModel r c) (d : DeterministicRealization md)
    (N : K → Nat) (p : K → ℚ) (base : (k : K) → Ω → Sample (N k))
    (hlaw : ∀ k, ConditionalLaw law (N k) (p k) (base k))
    (n m : J → Nat) (alpha : J → ℚ) (key : J → K)
    (hn : ∀ j, n j ≤ N (key j))
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ alpha j)
    (hp0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) (hp1 : ∀ k, p k ≤ 1)
    (commands : Ω → List (RecorderReveal.Command K))
    (selectWarm selectCold : Ω → J) (wp cp : ℚ)
    (hwparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectWarm ω)) = wp)
    (hcparam : ∀ ω, p (key (selectCold ω)) = cp) :
    eventMass law (fun ω => ∃ planned,
      recorderPlan md n m alpha key (fun ω k => sampleList (base k ω)) commands
        selectWarm selectCold ω = some planned ∧
      ¬ EpisodeCertified planned wp cp d.warmSetup d.coldSetup d.warmGross d.coldGross) ≤
      ∑ j, alpha j

declarations.name: certified_bayesian_model_policy
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem certified_bayesian_model_policy
    (p : Protocol Ω P C claim)
    (model : Guarded.System (RationalBelief Ω × M) (Action P) (Option C))
    (phi : State Ω P → RationalBelief Ω × M)
    (W : ℕ → (RationalBelief Ω × M) → ℚ)
    (eps alpha beta : ℚ) (L R chi residual : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hc : Guarded.BayesianModelCertificate (controller p) model phi
      (fun s => s.belief) W eps alpha beta L R chi residual)
    (estimate : ℕ → State Ω P → Action P → ℚ)
    (choose : ℕ → State Ω P → Action P) (codeError tau : ℕ → ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ k s, Allowed p s (choose k s))
    (he : ∀ k s a, Allowed p s a →
      |Guarded.tableQ model (W k) (phi s) a - estimate k s a| ≤ codeError k)
    (hm : ∀ k s a, Allowed p s a → estimate k s a ≤ estimate k s (choose k s) + tau k)
    (B n : ℕ) (s : State Ω P) (hs : BudgetSafe claim B s) :
    Guarded.TreeSafe (controller p) (BudgetSafe claim B) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    0 ≤ Guarded.value (controller p) n s -
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    Guarded.value (controller p) n s -
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ≤
      Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 *
        (Guarded.modelQBudget eps (Guarded.bayesianTransportBudget alpha beta L R chi) residual k +
         codeError k) + tau k) n

theorem certified_approximate_policy [Fintype P] (p : Protocol Ω P C claim)
    (choose : ℕ → State Ω P → Action P)
    (estimate : ℕ → State Ω P → Action P → ℚ) (eta tau : ℕ → ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ n s, Allowed p s (choose n s))
    (he : ∀ n s a, Allowed p s a →
      |Guarded.qValue (controller p) n s a - estimate n s a| ≤ eta n)
    (hm : ∀ n s a, Allowed p s a →
      estimate n s a ≤ estimate n s (choose n s) + tau n)

    Guarded.TreeSafe (controller p) (BudgetSafe claim B) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    0 ≤ Guarded.value (controller p) n s -
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ∧
    Guarded.value (controller p) n s -
      Guarded.planValue (controller p) s (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p) choose n s) ≤
      Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 * eta k + tau k) n

    (q : RetryBayesian.Reliability Ω) (lim : Limits) (l : Ledger)
    (b : RationalBelief Ω) (old : Ticket) (hs : Safe lim l)
    (ht : l.terminal = false) (hp : l.published = false) (hc : l.current = some old)
    (hf : q.fee = old.fee) (hr : RetryBayesian.recommend q (state lim l b) = true) :

    lowerQ md h s a ≤ Guarded.qValue (trueSystem md r) h s a ∧
      Guarded.qValue (trueSystem md r) h s a ≤ upperQ md h s a

      c ∈ robustRows md h s ∧ ∀ d ∈ robustRows md h s, d.score ≤ c.score

declarations.statement_excerpt:

      lowerQ md h s a ≤ lowerQ md h s (robustChoice md h s)

declarations.name: certified_dominance
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem certified_dominance (md : QModel n m) (h : Nat) (s : State md)
    (a : Action) (_ha : a ∈ LazyStaged.actions (nominal md) s)
    (hd : ∀ b ∈ LazyStaged.actions (nominal md) s, upperQ md h s b ≤ lowerQ md h s a)
    (r : Realization md) :
    ∀ b ∈ (trueSystem md r).actions s,
      Guarded.qValue (trueSystem md r) h s b ≤ Guarded.qValue (trueSystem md r) h s a

declarations.name: robust_action_gap
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem robust_action_gap (md : QModel n m) (r : Realization md)
    (h : Nat) (s : State md) :
    Guarded.value (trueSystem md r) (h+1) s -
      Guarded.qValue (trueSystem md r) h s (robustChoice md h s) ≤
      2 * globalQRadius md h

    ∀ h s, robustPolicy md h s ∈ LazyStaged.actions (nominal md) s

declarations.name: robust_policy_nearGreedy
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem robust_policy_nearGreedy (md : QModel n m) (r : Realization md) :
    ∀ h s, Guarded.NearGreedy (trueSystem md r)
      (fun k => 2 * globalQRadius md k) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (trueSystem md r) (robustPolicy md) h s)

declarations.name: robust_policy_regret
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem robust_policy_regret (md : QModel n m) (r : Realization md)
    (h : Nat) (s : State md) :
    0 ≤ Guarded.value (trueSystem md r) h s -
      Guarded.planValue (trueSystem md r) s
        (Guarded.policyPlan (trueSystem md r) (robustPolicy md) h s) ∧
    Guarded.value (trueSystem md r) h s -
      Guarded.planValue (trueSystem md r) s
        (Guarded.policyPlan (trueSystem md r) (robustPolicy md) h s) ≤
      Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 * globalQRadius md k) h

declarations.name: acknowledge_fresh_contract
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem acknowledge_fresh_contract (md : QModel n m) (c d : Checkpoint md)
    (r : Commit md) (out : RobustQuote.Outcome md) (actual : StoreView md)
    (ev : EvidenceView n m) (hfresh : c.last ≠ some r)
    (h : acknowledge md c r out actual ev = .ok d) :
    r.intent.quoteEvidence = ev ∧ r.after = actual ∧
      r.intent.sequence = c.next ∧ r.intent.before = view c.state ∧
      out.tag = r.outcome ∧
      ∃ t, RobustQuote.confirm md c.state r.intent.action out = some t ∧
        view t = r.after ∧ d = ⟨c.next+1,t,some r⟩

    (he : r.intent.quoteEvidence = ev) (ha : r.after = actual)
    (hl : c.last = some r) (hn : c.next = r.intent.sequence+1)
    (hv : view c.state = actual) : acknowledge md c r out actual ev = .ok c

declarations.name: acknowledge_checked_transition
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem acknowledge_checked_transition (md : QModel n m) (c : Checkpoint md)
    (a : Action) (out : RobustQuote.Outcome md) (t : RobustQuote.RuntimeState md)
    (hc : RobustQuote.confirm md c.state a out = some t)
    (hl : c.last ≠ some (commitFor md c a out t)) :

    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω]

    {Coarse : Type w} [Fintype Coarse]
    {A : Type z}
    (prior : Ω → ℚ) (utility : Ω → A → ℚ)
    (E : RationalChannel Ω Fine) (K : RationalChannel Fine Coarse)

      ∑ x, K.prob x y * signalActionScore prior utility E x a

    (φ : S → Z) (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)

theorem constant_rate_verifier_ensemble_sandwich

declarations.name: executable_policy_regret
declarations.statement_excerpt:
theorem executable_policy_regret (p : Protocol Ω P C O)
    (tasks : List P) (candidates : List C) (ht : ∀ x, x ∈ tasks) (hc : ∀ c, c ∈ candidates)
    (R : ℚ) (hr : ∀ s a, Allowed p s a → |reward p s a| ≤ R)
    (depth : Nat → Nat) (hd : ∀ k, depth k ≤ k + 1) (n : Nat) (s : State Ω P) :
    0 ≤ Guarded.value (controller p) n s - Guarded.planValue (controller p) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p)
        (fun k t => ExecutablePlanner.choose (model p tasks candidates) (fun _ => .stop) (depth k) t) n s) ∧
    Guarded.value (controller p) n s - Guarded.planValue (controller p) s
      (Guarded.policyPlan (controller p)
        (fun k t => ExecutablePlanner.choose (model p tasks candidates) (fun _ => .stop) (depth k) t) n s) ≤
    Guarded.regretBudget (fun k => 2 * ((k + 1 - depth k : Nat) : ℚ) * R) n

Module counts are not counts of independent discoveries
